summary: Pondera County lookout on the Lewis and Clark National Forest; sources date its start 1924-1933, it was abandoned in 1973 and is gone, and no source describes the site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Sources disagree on the start. A 1924 newspaper implies a lookout existed; firelookout.com lists a camp in 1928 and an L-4 cab in 1933; a November 1932 newspaper says a lookout was built on Half Dome that year at about $600. The story gives all three without choosing.

A 1963 Coast and Geodetic Survey description gives a 10 by 20 foot lookout house, while firelookout.com's standard R-6 design is 15 by 15 feet. No source explains the difference, so the story reports both.
